race.comment: The marble has fallen nicely for RUNKLE CRUNCH NZ (3). He was runner-up to MAD MONDAY in the 4YO Classic last start but drew on that rival's outside there. Importantly starts inside him tonight and he led to win the 4YO Championship here prior. Won last year's WA Derby over this longer distance and the draw should give him the chance to go forward and dictate. The swing in barrier fortunes may have gone against MAD MONDAY (6) tonight but he is the most progressive member of this age group and has been impressive in winning his two starts here off a spell. Proven at the longer trip and strikes at 50 per cent when third-up so should be peaking. LAZI DAIS (2) led to find winning form last week. This is stronger but the low draw helps him. The same can be said for LINCOLN LOU NZ (1) who was good from the back row when second to Runkle Crunch in the 4YO Championship two back. CYCLONE JORDY NZ (9) is struggling to find his best and cops the outside barrier but is too good to dismiss completely.
